blocks.text: KIDAPAWAN CITY, Cotabato Province — The Kidapawan City government has provided an initial 10 walk-through metal detectors to some of the largest public schools to bolster campus security for students and faculty. Mayor Jose Paolo Evangelista turned over the security equipment during Monday’s flag-raising ceremony held at the city gymnasium. Miguel Filalan, Kidapawan City Schools
